card.name: Proton pump inhibitor and bismuth text
card.fires_on: Linking words, spaces and word parts in text about proton pump inhibitors (omeprazole, esomeprazole) and bismuth combination products. Often just before a number, a drug name or the start of 'bismuth' or 'bifidobacteria'.

modes.label: Linking words in bismuth combo names
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'containing' inside or next to bismuth, metronidazole, tetracycline or probiotic product names.
modes.example: Do not administer bismuth subcitrate potassium, metronidazole<< and>> tetracycline hydrochloride capsules

modes.label: Spaces and 'of' in PPI dosing text
modes.description: A space before a dose number, or 'of' after efficacy or dosage, in omeprazole or esomeprazole labels.
modes.example: 4 to 8 weeks 1 10 to less than 20 kg: 10 mg 20 kg and greater:<< >>20 mg Maintenance of Healing of EE

modes.label: Inside PPI drug names
modes.description: The end of a PPI name in a list of acid-reducing drugs.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words starting with B, as in bismuth or bifidobacteria, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small words and gaps in acid-reducer and bismuth ulcer-treatment text, where a B-word like bismuth may come next.
